pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions, primarily quadrilaterals and pentagons, exhibiting smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is largest on the upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a complete lattice. Junction nodes exhibit primarily tri-radial and tetra-radial connectivity. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform, maintaining a consistent pixel width between adjacent patches.
